description: Fire is not merely a disturbance, but a foundational force that has shaped North America's landscape for millennia. In this course students will explore multiple aspects of fire dynamics including the ecology of fire, and the cultural history of fire in indigenous communities, and the economic and social forces that drive fire policy in the U.S. Students will also get hands-on experience participating in prescribed burning in St. Olaf's natural lands.
fullname: Advanced Research Topics in Environmental Studies
